{{Quote|He was a Talz named Bama Vook. He was an excellent pilot, even if he was sometimes a bit reckless.|Boll Trinkatta|<ref name="Episode I Adventures 2: The Bartokk Assassins">''[[Episode I Adventures 2: The Bartokk Assassins]]''</ref>}}
'''Bama Vook''' was a [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who worked for [[Trinkatta Starships]] around the year [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]. He had a son named [[Chup-Chup]] who was kidnapped by [[Bartokk]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] hired by [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].

He wore a [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]] to translate his speech into [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].
